SELECT a.account_id, a.account_name, CASE WHEN a.account_type = 1 THEN '요양원' WHEN a.account_type = 4 THEN '산업체' WHEN a.account_type = 5 THEN '학교' ELSE '' END as account_type_name, CASE WHEN a.meal_type = 1 THEN '요양주간' WHEN a.meal_type = 2 THEN '요양직원' WHEN a.meal_type = 3 THEN '요양' WHEN a.meal_type = 4 THEN '주간보호' ELSE '산업체' END as meal_type_name, abm.year, abm.month, abm.total, abm.diet_price, abm.utility_bills, abm.food_budget, abm.budget_total, abm.day_budget, abm.day_use_amount, abm.use_ratio, abm.note, abm.budget_grant, abm.day_use_ratio, abm.existing_budget, abm.diff_amount, abm.first_sales, -- 소모품 예산/누계 (tb_account_supplies_budget 별도 테이블 JOIN) IFNULL(asb.supplies_budget, 0) AS supplies_budget, IFNULL(asb.supplies_used, 0) AS supplies_used, IFNULL(asb.supplies_remaining, 0) AS supplies_remaining, IFNULL(asb.supplies_cumulative, 0) AS supplies_cumulative, IFNULL(asb.event_budget, 0) AS event_budget, IFNULL(asb.event_used, 0) AS event_used, IFNULL(asb.event_remaining, 0) AS event_remaining, IFNULL(asb.event_cumulative, 0) AS event_cumulative, -- 전월 예산부여금액 서브쿼리 (SELECT IFNULL(abm_prev.budget_grant, 0) FROM tb_account_budget_management abm_prev WHERE abm_prev.account_id = a.account_id AND abm_prev.year = CASE WHEN #{month} = 1 THEN #{year} - 1 ELSE #{year} END AND abm_prev.month = CASE WHEN #{month} = 1 THEN 12 ELSE #{month} - 1 END LIMIT 1) AS prev_budget_grant FROM tb_account a -- 식자재 예산 테이블 JOIN LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_account_budget_management abm ON abm.account_id = a.account_id AND abm.year = #{year} AND abm.month = #{month} -- 소모품 예산/누계 전용 테이블 JOIN LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_account_supplies_budget asb ON asb.account_id = a.account_id AND asb.year = #{year} AND asb.month = LPAD(#{month}, 2, '0') WHERE a.account_id NOT IN ( 20260122065002, 20260122071337, 20260122071857, 20260122072114, 20260122072245, 20260122072529, 20260122072732, 20260219024021 -- 사랑복지센터: 식수/예산을 사랑복지요양원(20250819193615)에 통합 운영 중이라 예산관리 화면에서 제외 ) AND a.del_yn = 'N'
AND a.account_id = #{account_id}

WITH params AS ( SELECT STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', LPAD(#{month}, 2, '0'), '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') AS month_start, LAST_DAY(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', LPAD(#{month}, 2, '0'), '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d')) AS month_end, DAY(LAST_DAY(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', LPAD(#{month}, 2, '0'), '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'))) AS month_days,
DATE(CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), '+00:00', '+09:00')) AS today, 3600000 AS utility_month_salary, 330000 AS integration_account_cost ),
member_period AS ( SELECT am.member_id, am.account_id, IFNULL(am.position_type, 0) AS position_type, IFNULL(am.salary, 0) AS monthly_salary, GREATEST(COALESCE(DATE(am.act_join_dt), DATE(am.join_dt), p.month_start), p.month_start) AS cost_start,
LEAST( COALESCE( CASE WHEN am.del_dt IS NOT NULL AND (ws.work_system REGEXP '^[0-9]+근[0-9]+휴' OR ws.work_system LIKE '격일%') THEN DATE_ADD(DATE(am.del_dt), INTERVAL 1 DAY) ELSE DATE(am.del_dt) END, p.month_end ), p.month_end ) AS cost_end, p.today, p.month_days, p.utility_month_salary, p.integration_account_cost FROM tb_account_members am CROSS JOIN params p LEFT JOIN tb_account_member_work_system ws ON ws.idx = am.idx AND IFNULL(ws.del_yn, 'N') != 'Y' WHERE COALESCE(DATE(am.act_join_dt), DATE(am.join_dt), p.month_start) <= p.month_end AND (am.del_dt IS NULL OR DATE(am.del_dt) >= p.month_start) AND (IFNULL(am.del_yn, 'N') != 'Y' OR am.del_dt IS NOT NULL) ),
member_last_record_month AS ( SELECT ar.member_id, MAX(ar.record_date) AS last_record_date FROM tb_account_record ar WHERE ar.record_year = #{year} AND ar.record_month = #{month} GROUP BY ar.member_id ), member_month_cost AS ( -- 재직 구간만큼 급여를 일할 계산 (전 직군 공통, 유틸/통합은 아래에서 별도 배분 방식 적용) SELECT mp.*, (mp.monthly_salary / mp.month_days) * (DATEDIFF(mp.cost_end, mp.cost_start) + 1) AS prorated_salary,
(mp.monthly_salary / mp.month_days) * GREATEST(DATEDIFF(LEAST(mp.cost_end, mp.today), mp.cost_start) + 1, 0) AS prorated_salary_today,
LEAST( mp.cost_end, COALESCE( STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', LPAD(#{month}, 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(lrm.last_record_date, 2, '0')), '%Y-%m-%d'), mp.cost_end ) ) AS cost_end_month_capped, (mp.monthly_salary / mp.month_days) * GREATEST( DATEDIFF( LEAST( mp.cost_end, COALESCE( STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', LPAD(#{month}, 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(lrm.last_record_date, 2, '0')), '%Y-%m-%d'), mp.cost_end ) ), mp.cost_start ) + 1, 0) AS prorated_salary_month_capped FROM member_period mp LEFT JOIN member_last_record_month lrm ON lrm.member_id = mp.member_id WHERE mp.cost_start <= mp.cost_end ),
regular_absence_days_today AS ( SELECT ar.member_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ar.record_date) AS absence_days_today FROM tb_account_record ar JOIN member_month_cost mc ON mc.member_id = ar.member_id AND mc.position_type NOT IN (6, 7) WHERE ar.record_year = #{year} AND ar.record_month = #{month} AND ar.type = 4 AND STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT(ar.record_year, '-', LPAD(ar.record_month, 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(ar.record_date, 2, '0')), '%Y-%m-%d' ) BETWEEN mc.cost_start AND LEAST(mc.cost_end, mc.today) GROUP BY ar.member_id ),
regular_overtime_hours_today AS ( SELECT ar.member_id, SUM(CAST(NULLIF(ar.note, '') AS DECIMAL(10,1))) AS overtime_hours FROM tb_account_record ar JOIN member_month_cost mc ON mc.member_id = ar.member_id AND mc.position_type NOT IN (6, 7) WHERE ar.record_year = #{year} AND ar.record_month = #{month} AND ar.type = 3 AND STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT(ar.record_year, '-', LPAD(ar.record_month, 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(ar.record_date, 2, '0')), '%Y-%m-%d' ) BETWEEN mc.cost_start AND LEAST(mc.cost_end, mc.today) GROUP BY ar.member_id ),
regular_early_leave_hours_today AS ( SELECT ar.member_id, SUM(CAST(NULLIF(ar.note, '') AS DECIMAL(10,1))) AS early_leave_hours FROM tb_account_record ar JOIN member_month_cost mc ON mc.member_id = ar.member_id AND mc.position_type NOT IN (6, 7) WHERE ar.record_year = #{year} AND ar.record_month = #{month} AND ar.type = 17 AND STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT(ar.record_year, '-', LPAD(ar.record_month, 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(ar.record_date, 2, '0')), '%Y-%m-%d' ) BETWEEN mc.cost_start AND LEAST(mc.cost_end, mc.today) GROUP BY ar.member_id ), regular_cost_today_by_hours AS ( -- 🔹 "260910_ERP예산관리 프로그램_급여 참고자료.xlsx"의 "1.급여대장" 시트 V열(근태차감) -- 실제 셀 수식을 exceljs로 직접 열어서 확인한 결과: -- V7 = -(월급 / $Q$3 / N8 × VLOOKUP(...,20,0)) -- 여기서 $Q$3는 "3.근무타입" 시트가 아니라 "1.급여대장" 시트 자체의 Q3이고, -- Q3 = P3(말일=31)-O3(초일=1)+1 = 그냥 "이번 달 전체 일수"였다(주 단위 4.3452가 아니었음). -- N8은 그 직원 행의 "1일 소정근로시간"(근무타입 마스터 값), VLOOKUP(...,20,0)은 -- "2.직원관리" 시트 20번째 컬럼 = "결근시간"(시간 단위, 직접 입력값). -- 즉 시급 = 월급 ÷ 월전체일수 ÷ 일소정근로시간 (소정근로시간이 아니라 달력일수 기준). -- 결근 "하루"는 시급×일소정시간 = 월급÷월전체일수 이므로 결국 달력 일할계산과 같아진다. SELECT mc.member_id, mc.prorated_salary_today - ((mc.monthly_salary / mc.month_days) * IFNULL(ad.absence_days_today, 0)) + ((mc.monthly_salary / mc.month_days / ws.daily_standard_hours) * IFNULL(el.early_leave_hours, 0)) + ((mc.monthly_salary / mc.month_days / ws.daily_standard_hours) * IFNULL(ot.overtime_hours, 0) * 1.5) AS cost_today_hours FROM member_month_cost mc JOIN tb_account_members am ON am.member_id = mc.member_id JOIN tb_account_member_work_system ws ON ws.idx = am.idx AND IFNULL(ws.del_yn, 'N') != 'Y' AND ws.daily_standard_hours IS NOT NULL AND ws.monthly_standard_hours > 0 LEFT JOIN regular_absence_days_today ad ON ad.member_id = mc.member_id LEFT JOIN regular_overtime_hours_today ot ON ot.member_id = mc.member_id LEFT JOIN regular_early_leave_hours_today el ON el.member_id = mc.member_id WHERE mc.position_type NOT IN (6, 7) ),
regular_absence_days_month AS ( SELECT ar.member_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ar.record_date) AS absence_days_month FROM tb_account_record ar JOIN member_month_cost mc ON mc.member_id = ar.member_id AND mc.position_type NOT IN (6, 7) WHERE ar.record_year = #{year} AND ar.record_month = #{month} AND ar.type = 4 AND STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT(ar.record_year, '-', LPAD(ar.record_month, 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(ar.record_date, 2, '0')), '%Y-%m-%d' ) BETWEEN mc.cost_start AND mc.cost_end_month_capped GROUP BY ar.member_id ), regular_overtime_hours_month AS ( SELECT ar.member_id, SUM(CAST(NULLIF(ar.note, '') AS DECIMAL(10,1))) AS overtime_hours FROM tb_account_record ar JOIN member_month_cost mc ON mc.member_id = ar.member_id AND mc.position_type NOT IN (6, 7) WHERE ar.record_year = #{year} AND ar.record_month = #{month} AND ar.type = 3 AND STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT(ar.record_year, '-', LPAD(ar.record_month, 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(ar.record_date, 2, '0')), '%Y-%m-%d' ) BETWEEN mc.cost_start AND mc.cost_end_month_capped GROUP BY ar.member_id ), regular_early_leave_hours_month AS ( SELECT ar.member_id, SUM(CAST(NULLIF(ar.note, '') AS DECIMAL(10,1))) AS early_leave_hours FROM tb_account_record ar JOIN member_month_cost mc ON mc.member_id = ar.member_id AND mc.position_type NOT IN (6, 7) WHERE ar.record_year = #{year} AND ar.record_month = #{month} AND ar.type = 17 AND STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT(ar.record_year, '-', LPAD(ar.record_month, 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(ar.record_date, 2, '0')), '%Y-%m-%d' ) BETWEEN mc.cost_start AND mc.cost_end_month_capped GROUP BY ar.member_id ), regular_cost_month_by_hours AS ( SELECT mc.member_id, mc.prorated_salary_month_capped - ((mc.monthly_salary / mc.month_days) * IFNULL(adm.absence_days_month, 0)) + ((mc.monthly_salary / mc.month_days / ws.daily_standard_hours) * IFNULL(elm.early_leave_hours, 0)) + ((mc.monthly_salary / mc.month_days / ws.daily_standard_hours) * IFNULL(otm.overtime_hours, 0) * 1.5) AS cost_month_hours FROM member_month_cost mc JOIN tb_account_members am ON am.member_id = mc.member_id JOIN tb_account_member_work_system ws ON ws.idx = am.idx AND IFNULL(ws.del_yn, 'N') != 'Y' AND ws.daily_standard_hours IS NOT NULL AND ws.monthly_standard_hours > 0 LEFT JOIN regular_absence_days_month adm ON adm.member_id = mc.member_id LEFT JOIN regular_overtime_hours_month otm ON otm.member_id = mc.member_id LEFT JOIN regular_early_leave_hours_month elm ON elm.member_id = mc.member_id WHERE mc.position_type NOT IN (6, 7) ),
regular_cost AS ( SELECT mc.account_id, ROUND(SUM(mc.prorated_salary), 0) AS regular_person_cost,
ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(rcth.cost_today_hours, mc.prorated_salary_today)), 0) AS regular_person_cost_today,
ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(rcmh.cost_month_hours, mc.prorated_salary_month_capped)), 0) AS estimated_regular_person_cost,
ROUND(SUM(mc.prorated_salary * 1.2), 0) AS regular_person_cost_secured, ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(rcth.cost_today_hours, mc.prorated_salary_today) * 1.2), 0) AS regular_person_cost_today_secured, ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(rcmh.cost_month_hours, mc.prorated_salary_month_capped) * 1.2), 0) AS estimated_regular_person_cost_secured FROM member_month_cost mc LEFT JOIN regular_cost_today_by_hours rcth ON rcth.member_id = mc.member_id LEFT JOIN regular_cost_month_by_hours rcmh ON rcmh.member_id = mc.member_id WHERE mc.position_type NOT IN (6, 7) GROUP BY mc.account_id ),
rec_period AS ( SELECT rm.member_id, rm.account_id, IFNULL(rm.salary, 0) AS monthly_salary, GREATEST(COALESCE(DATE(rm.act_join_dt), p.month_start), p.month_start) AS cost_start,
LEAST(p.month_end, p.today) AS cost_end, p.month_days FROM tb_account_rec_management rm CROSS JOIN params p WHERE rm.use_yn = 'D' AND COALESCE(DATE(rm.act_join_dt), p.month_start) <= p.month_end ), rec_month_cost AS ( -- cost_start > cost_end(=실입사일이 오늘보다 미래이거나, 조회월이 아직 시작 전인 경우)는 자동으로 제외됨 SELECT rp.*, (rp.monthly_salary / rp.month_days) * (DATEDIFF(rp.cost_end, rp.cost_start) + 1) AS prorated_salary FROM rec_period rp WHERE rp.cost_start <= rp.cost_end ), rec_cost AS ( -- rec_month_cost.cost_end가 이미 LEAST(month_end, 오늘)로 캡되어 있어서 -- rec_person_cost 자체가 항상 "오늘 기준" 값과 같다 (과거 월 조회 시엔 오늘>=month_end라 당월 전체 값과도 같아짐) SELECT account_id, ROUND(SUM(prorated_salary), 0) AS rec_person_cost, ROUND(SUM(prorated_salary * 1.2), 0) AS rec_person_cost_secured FROM rec_month_cost GROUP BY account_id ),
utility_attendance AS ( -- 유틸 직원이 업장별로 출근한 일수 (한 업장에서 며칠 근무했는지) SELECT ur.member_id, ur.account_id, COUNT(*) AS workplace_days FROM tb_account_util_record ur JOIN member_month_cost mc ON mc.member_id = ur.member_id AND mc.position_type = 6 WHERE ur.record_year = #{year} AND ur.record_month = #{month} AND ur.is_present = 'Y' AND NULLIF(ur.account_id, '') IS NOT NULL AND STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT(ur.record_year, '-', LPAD(ur.record_month, 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(ur.record_date, 2, '0')), '%Y-%m-%d' ) BETWEEN mc.cost_start AND mc.cost_end GROUP BY ur.member_id, ur.account_id ), utility_total_days AS ( -- 유틸 직원의 이번 달 전체 출근일수 (업장 구분 없이 합산) SELECT member_id, SUM(workplace_days) AS total_days FROM utility_attendance GROUP BY member_id ), utility_cost AS ( SELECT ua.account_id, ROUND(SUM( (mc.utility_month_salary / mc.month_days) * (DATEDIFF(mc.cost_end, mc.cost_start) + 1) / utd.total_days * ua.workplace_days ), 0) AS utility_person_cost, ROUND(SUM( (mc.utility_month_salary / mc.month_days) * (DATEDIFF(mc.cost_end, mc.cost_start) + 1) / utd.total_days * ua.workplace_days * 1.2 ), 0) AS utility_person_cost_secured FROM utility_attendance ua JOIN utility_total_days utd ON utd.member_id = ua.member_id JOIN member_month_cost mc ON mc.member_id = ua.member_id AND mc.position_type = 6 GROUP BY ua.account_id ),
integration_workplace AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ar.member_id, ar.account_id FROM tb_account_record ar JOIN member_month_cost mc ON mc.member_id = ar.member_id AND mc.position_type = 7 WHERE ar.record_year = #{year} AND ar.record_month = #{month} AND ar.type = 20 AND STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT(ar.record_year, '-', LPAD(ar.record_month, 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(ar.record_date, 2, '0')), '%Y-%m-%d' ) BETWEEN mc.cost_start AND mc.cost_end ), integration_cost AS ( SELECT iw.account_id, COUNT(*) * MAX(mc.integration_account_cost) AS integration_person_cost, ROUND(COUNT(*) * MAX(mc.integration_account_cost) * 1.2, 0) AS integration_person_cost_secured FROM integration_workplace iw JOIN member_month_cost mc ON mc.member_id = iw.member_id AND mc.position_type = 7 GROUP BY iw.account_id ),
utility_attendance_today AS ( SELECT ur.member_id, ur.account_id, COUNT(*) AS workplace_days_today FROM tb_account_util_record ur JOIN member_month_cost mc ON mc.member_id = ur.member_id AND mc.position_type = 6 WHERE ur.record_year = #{year} AND ur.record_month = #{month} AND ur.is_present = 'Y' AND NULLIF(ur.account_id, '') IS NOT NULL AND STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT(ur.record_year, '-', LPAD(ur.record_month, 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(ur.record_date, 2, '0')), '%Y-%m-%d' ) BETWEEN mc.cost_start AND LEAST(mc.cost_end, mc.today) GROUP BY ur.member_id, ur.account_id ), utility_total_days_today AS ( SELECT member_id, SUM(workplace_days_today) AS total_days_today FROM utility_attendance_today GROUP BY member_id ), utility_cost_today AS ( SELECT ua.account_id, ROUND(SUM( mc.prorated_salary_today / utd.total_days_today * ua.workplace_days_today ), 0) AS utility_person_cost_today, ROUND(SUM( mc.prorated_salary_today / utd.total_days_today * ua.workplace_days_today * 1.2 ), 0) AS utility_person_cost_today_secured FROM utility_attendance_today ua JOIN utility_total_days_today utd ON utd.member_id = ua.member_id JOIN member_month_cost mc ON mc.member_id = ua.member_id AND mc.position_type = 6 GROUP BY ua.account_id ),
integration_workplace_today AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ar.member_id, ar.account_id FROM tb_account_record ar JOIN member_month_cost mc ON mc.member_id = ar.member_id AND mc.position_type = 7 WHERE ar.record_year = #{year} AND ar.record_month = #{month} AND ar.type = 20 AND STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT(ar.record_year, '-', LPAD(ar.record_month, 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(ar.record_date, 2, '0')), '%Y-%m-%d' ) BETWEEN mc.cost_start AND LEAST(mc.cost_end, mc.today) ), integration_cost_today AS ( SELECT iw.account_id, COUNT(*) * MAX(mc.integration_account_cost) AS integration_person_cost_today, ROUND(COUNT(*) * MAX(mc.integration_account_cost) * 1.2, 0) AS integration_person_cost_today_secured FROM integration_workplace_today iw JOIN member_month_cost mc ON mc.member_id = iw.member_id AND mc.position_type = 7 GROUP BY iw.account_id ),
overtime_detail AS ( SELECT ar.account_id, ROUND(SUM(CAST(NULLIF(ar.note, '') AS DECIMAL(10,1))), 1) AS overtime_hours FROM tb_account_record ar CROSS JOIN params p WHERE ar.record_year = #{year} AND ar.record_month = #{month} AND ar.type = 3 AND STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT(ar.record_year, '-', LPAD(ar.record_month, 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(ar.record_date, 2, '0')), '%Y-%m-%d' ) <= p.today GROUP BY ar.account_id ),
absence_detail AS ( SELECT ar.account_id, COUNT(*) AS absence_count FROM tb_account_record ar CROSS JOIN params p WHERE ar.record_year = #{year} AND ar.record_month = #{month} AND ar.type = 4 AND STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT(ar.record_year, '-', LPAD(ar.record_month, 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(ar.record_date, 2, '0')), '%Y-%m-%d' ) <= p.today GROUP BY ar.account_id ),
dispatch_detail AS ( SELECT d.account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN r.is_present = 'Y' THEN IFNULL(r.salary, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS dispatch_amount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.is_present = 'Y' THEN IFNULL(r.salary, 0) * 1.2 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS dispatch_amount_secured, SUM(CASE WHEN r.is_present = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dispatch_count FROM tb_account_members_dispatch d JOIN tb_account_record_dispatch r ON r.account_id = d.account_id AND r.member_id = d.member_id AND r.record_year = d.record_year AND r.record_month = d.record_month CROSS JOIN params p WHERE d.record_year = #{year} AND d.record_month = #{month} AND STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT(r.record_year, '-', LPAD(r.record_month, 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(r.record_date, 2, '0')), '%Y-%m-%d' ) <= p.today GROUP BY d.account_id ),
employee_dispatch_detail AS ( SELECT ar.account_id, SUM(IFNULL(ar.salary, 0)) AS employee_dispatch_amount, ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(ar.salary, 0) * 1.2), 0) AS employee_dispatch_amount_secured, COUNT(*) AS employee_dispatch_count FROM tb_account_record ar CROSS JOIN params p WHERE ar.record_year = #{year} AND ar.record_month = #{month} AND ar.type = 6 AND STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT(ar.record_year, '-', LPAD(ar.record_month, 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(ar.record_date, 2, '0')), '%Y-%m-%d' ) <= p.today GROUP BY ar.account_id ),
util_detail AS ( -- ⚠️ 유틸 전용 테이블(tb_account_util_record)이지만 실제로는 다른 직군(통합 등) 기록이 잘못 섞여 들어오는 -- 경우가 있어서, utility_attendance(기존 메인 계산)와 동일하게 position_type=6(유틸) 인원만 카운트한다 SELECT ur.account_id, COUNT(*) AS util_count FROM tb_account_util_record ur JOIN member_month_cost mc ON mc.member_id = ur.member_id AND mc.position_type = 6 CROSS JOIN params p WHERE ur.record_year = #{year} AND ur.record_month = #{month} AND ur.is_present = 'Y' AND NULLIF(ur.account_id, '') IS NOT NULL AND STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT(ur.record_year, '-', LPAD(ur.record_month, 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(ur.record_date, 2, '0')), '%Y-%m-%d' ) <= p.today GROUP BY ur.account_id ),
overtime_detail_month AS ( SELECT ar.account_id, ROUND(SUM(CAST(NULLIF(ar.note, '') AS DECIMAL(10,1))), 1) AS overtime_hours_month FROM tb_account_record ar WHERE ar.record_year = #{year} AND ar.record_month = #{month} AND ar.type = 3 GROUP BY ar.account_id ), absence_detail_month AS ( SELECT ar.account_id, COUNT(*) AS absence_count_month FROM tb_account_record ar WHERE ar.record_year = #{year} AND ar.record_month = #{month} AND ar.type = 4 GROUP BY ar.account_id ), dispatch_detail_month AS ( SELECT d.account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN r.is_present = 'Y' THEN IFNULL(r.salary, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS dispatch_amount_month, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.is_present = 'Y' THEN IFNULL(r.salary, 0) * 1.2 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS dispatch_amount_month_secured, SUM(CASE WHEN r.is_present = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dispatch_count_month FROM tb_account_members_dispatch d JOIN tb_account_record_dispatch r ON r.account_id = d.account_id AND r.member_id = d.member_id AND r.record_year = d.record_year AND r.record_month = d.record_month WHERE d.record_year = #{year} AND d.record_month = #{month} GROUP BY d.account_id ), employee_dispatch_detail_month AS ( SELECT ar.account_id, SUM(IFNULL(ar.salary, 0)) AS employee_dispatch_amount_month, ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(ar.salary, 0) * 1.2), 0) AS employee_dispatch_amount_month_secured, COUNT(*) AS employee_dispatch_count_month FROM tb_account_record ar WHERE ar.record_year = #{year} AND ar.record_month = #{month} AND ar.type = 6 GROUP BY ar.account_id ), util_detail_month AS ( SELECT ur.account_id, COUNT(*) AS util_count_month FROM tb_account_util_record ur JOIN member_month_cost mc ON mc.member_id = ur.member_id AND mc.position_type = 6 WHERE ur.record_year = #{year} AND ur.record_month = #{month} AND ur.is_present = 'Y' AND NULLIF(ur.account_id, '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ur.account_id ),
account_base AS ( SELECT a.account_id, a.account_name, CASE WHEN #{month} <= 2 THEN #{year} - 1 ELSE #{year} END AS base_year, CASE WHEN #{month} <= 2 THEN #{month} + 10 ELSE #{month} - 2 END AS base_month FROM tb_account a WHERE a.del_yn = 'N' AND a.account_id NOT IN ( 20260122065002, 20260122071337, 20260122071857, 20260122072114, 20260122072245, 20260122072529, 20260122072732 )

mapper.select:
WITH base AS ( SELECT A.is_present, B.position_type, STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT(A.record_year,'-',LPAD(A.record_month,2,'0'),'-',LPAD(A.record_date,2,'0')), '%Y-%m-%d' ) AS d FROM tb_account_record A JOIN tb_account_members B ON B.account_id = A.account_id AND B.member_id = A.member_id WHERE A.record_year = #{year} AND A.record_month = #{month} AND A.account_id = #{account_id} AND B.position_type IN (4,5)
UNION ALL
SELECT A.is_present, B.position_type, STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT(A.record_year,'-',LPAD(A.record_month,2,'0'),'-',LPAD(A.record_date,2,'0')), '%Y-%m-%d' ) AS d FROM tb_account_record_dispatch A JOIN tb_account_members_dispatch B ON B.account_id = A.account_id AND B.member_id = A.member_id WHERE A.record_year = #{year} AND A.record_month = #{month} AND A.account_id = #{account_id} AND B.position_type IN (4,5) ), params AS ( SELECT STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', LPAD(#{month}, 2, '0'), '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') AS first_day, LAST_DAY(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', LPAD(#{month}, 2, '0'), '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d')) AS last_day, DATE_SUB( STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', LPAD(#{month}, 2, '0'), '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', LPAD(#{month}, 2, '0'), '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d')) DAY ) AS month_week1_monday ), wk AS ( SELECT b.*, DATE_SUB(b.d, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(b.d) DAY) AS week_monday FROM base b ) SELECT FLOOR(DATEDIFF(w.week_monday, p.month_week1_monday) / 7) + 1 AS week_number,
CASE
WHEN DATE_ADD(w.week_monday, INTERVAL 0 DAY) < p.first_day OR DATE_ADD(w.week_monday, INTERVAL 0 DAY) > p.last_day
THEN 'none' ELSE CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(w.d)=2 AND w.is_present='Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CHAR) END AS 'mon',
CASE
WHEN DATE_ADD(w.week_monday, INTERVAL 1 DAY) < p.first_day OR DATE_ADD(w.week_monday, INTERVAL 1 DAY) > p.last_day
THEN 'none' ELSE CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(w.d)=3 AND w.is_present='Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CHAR) END AS 'tue',
CASE
WHEN DATE_ADD(w.week_monday, INTERVAL 2 DAY) < p.first_day OR DATE_ADD(w.week_monday, INTERVAL 2 DAY) > p.last_day
THEN 'none' ELSE CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(w.d)=4 AND w.is_present='Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CHAR) END AS 'wed',
CASE
WHEN DATE_ADD(w.week_monday, INTERVAL 3 DAY) < p.first_day OR DATE_ADD(w.week_monday, INTERVAL 3 DAY) > p.last_day
THEN 'none' ELSE CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(w.d)=5 AND w.is_present='Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CHAR) END AS 'thu',
CASE
WHEN DATE_ADD(w.week_monday, INTERVAL 4 DAY) < p.first_day OR DATE_ADD(w.week_monday, INTERVAL 4 DAY) > p.last_day
THEN 'none' ELSE CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(w.d)=6 AND w.is_present='Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CHAR) END AS 'fri',
CASE
WHEN DATE_ADD(w.week_monday, INTERVAL 5 DAY) < p.first_day OR DATE_ADD(w.week_monday, INTERVAL 5 DAY) > p.last_day
THEN 'none' ELSE CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(w.d)=7 AND w.is_present='Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CHAR) END AS 'sat',
CASE
WHEN DATE_ADD(w.week_monday, INTERVAL 6 DAY) < p.first_day OR DATE_ADD(w.week_monday, INTERVAL 6 DAY) > p.last_day
THEN 'none' ELSE CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(w.d)=1 AND w.is_present='Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CHAR) END AS 'sun',
w.position_type FROM wk w CROSS JOIN params p GROUP BY w.week_monday, w.position_type, p.month_week1_monday ORDER BY week_number, w.position_type;

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_recipe_image (recipe_id, menu_id, file_id, file_name, file_url, file_path, file_size, is_primary, sort_order, created_at) VALUES (#{recipe_id}, #{menu_id}, #{file_id}, #{file_name}, #{file_url}, #{file_path}, #{file_size}, IFNULL(#{is_primary}, 'N'), IFNULL(#{sort_order}, 0), DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR))
